email.email_verification.body:
Hello {name},

To verify the email address of your Storycreep account at {site}, open this link within {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}:

{url}

If you did not create an account at {site}, you can ignore this email.
email.email_verification.subject: Verify your email address for Storycreep
email.password_reset.body:
Hello {name},

Someone asked to reset the password of your Storycreep account at {site}. To choose a new password, open this link within {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. It works once, and signs your account out everywhere:

{url}

If it was not you, you can ignore this email, and your password stays as it is.
email.password_reset.subject: Reset your Storycreep password
